problems_fixed.what: Format conversion (spec special-case L10): every problem converted from input_type single_value (asking one x via 'Find the positive/larger/sum/how-many') to input_type two_solutions ending 'Give the two x-values.', with solutions = both x-values. Both pairs verified to satisfy BOTH equations for all 20 problems.

opener_concept: Guess-the-number: 'I square my number and get 12 more than the number itself' (x^2 = x + 12). A student tries values and finds BOTH roots 4 and -3 by common sense; the reveal names it as a line y=x+12 meeting the curve y=x^2 at two points, so there are two x-values.
notes: Trust-nothing fresh-solve of all 20 problems (8 bronze / 7 silver / 5 gold) from their displays. Original bank stored only ONE x per problem (single_value) with varied asks; converted all to two_solutions per the L10 spec special-case. Three genuine duplicate-answer-within-tier diseases found and fixed with minimal clean-integer re-poses (bronze[4], silver[2], silver[5]); silver[5] was also equation-identical to a bronze problem. No stored answer was mathematically wrong once the intended ask was read, but the single-value format hid the second root the topic is about. Added full guided_steps to every problem (each box recomputed and asserted; every solution pair re-checked in both equations), phase:'substitute' completion boundaries (set-up pre-worked, roots + back-substitution + check left live), per-problem hint, tier descriptions, three fresh teach walks (bronze y=5x/y=x^2+4 {1,4}; silver y=4x-5/y=x^2-x+1 {2,3}; gold x+y=6/x^2+y^2=20 {2,4}, none in the bank), three tier_guides, a slim method_card, and honest misconceptions: factor_sign_flip (expect = the sign-reversed roots, derived by committing the error, never equal to the correct pair), divide_by_x and one_root_only and square_bracket_error (expect null, indeterminate as a pair). Preserved topic_links, related_videos, worked_examples byte-for-byte vs pre-PATCH live. No em dashes, no U+FFFD. Validator PASS; live readback byte-matches the shard.
